name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Operations & Office Management | Vendors, Budgets, Team Support & Day-to-Day Operations
summary: Operations generalist with 15+ years keeping businesses and teams running: vendors and suppliers, budgets and invoices, scheduling, and the daily details nobody else has time for. Co-owned and ran a licensed Denver business, building its vendor, supplier, compliance, and customer-service operations from scratch. Led a team of 20 at Wix, overseeing budgets, scope, hiring support, and training. Runs every operational piece of Solenzo today, from contracts and invoicing to calendars and client meetings. Spent 15+ years in restaurant kitchens before that, where a clean, stocked, safe space is the job. Organized, discreet, and comfortable with Excel, Microsoft and Google tools, Zoom, and project-management software. Denver metro based, ready for three days a week on site.
